<!-- Generated by `ims gen docs` from .env.example. Do not edit: run `make docs-gen`. -->

Every setting lives in the environment. Copy `.env.example` to `.env` for local development; in
production systemd supplies an `EnvironmentFile`. Process environment always wins over `.env`
(precedence: `--env-file` → `APP_ENV_FILE` → `.env` → code defaults). `ims config:show` prints the
effective values with secrets masked.

**Commented** rows are optional: the code default applies until you set them.

| `APP_NAME` | `ims-go-saas-kit` |  |
| `APP_DEBUG` | `true` |  |
| `APP_URL` | `http://localhost:8080` |  |
| `APP_KEY` | — | `ims key:generate`; empty locally = a public dev key |
| `APP_PREVIOUS_KEYS` | — | *Optional.* old keys still accepted while rotating (comma-separated) |
| `APP_LISTEN_ADDR` | `:8080` |  |
| `APP_TIMEZONE` | `Asia/Dhaka` |  |
| `APP_LOCALE` | `en` | the default language (a registered code) |
| `APP_FALLBACK_LOCALE` | `en` | template language when a recipient's has no variant |

| `APP_LOG_LEVEL` | `info` |  |
| `APP_DATA_DIR` | `./var` |  |
| `APP_STORAGE_DIR` | `./var/storage` |  |

| `APP_ENV_FILE` | `./.env` | *Optional.* |

## Files & storage

| Variable | Example | Notes |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `FILES_DISK` | `public` | Disks work like Laravel's config/filesystems.php: code only names a disk, so moving uploads to S3 / Cloudflare R2 / MinIO is a change of FILES_DISK. Built-in disks: private (local, served by the app), public (local, served at /storage) and s3 (when S3_* is set). Private disks never get direct URLs. any disk name: private \| public \| s3 \| <STORAGE_DISKS name> |
| `FILES_PUBLIC_DISK` | `public` | *Optional.* where avatars go when FILES_DISK is private (must be public) |
| `STORAGE_PUBLIC_DIR` | `./var/storage/public` | *Optional.* |
| `STORAGE_PRIVATE_DIR` | `./var/storage/private` | *Optional.* |
| `DATA_PROCESSING_DISK` | `private` | any disk name |
| `DATA_PROCESSING_BASE_PATH` | `jobs` |  |
| `S3_ENDPOINT` | — | *Optional.* The built-in "s3" disk (AWS S3 or any S3-compatible service): empty for AWS; set for R2/MinIO/Spaces/B2 |
| `S3_REGION` | — | *Optional.* e.g. ap-southeast-1; "auto" for R2 |
| `S3_BUCKET` | — | *Optional.* |
| `S3_ACCESS_KEY` | — | *Optional.* |
| `S3_SECRET_KEY` | — | *Optional.* |
| `S3_PATH_STYLE` | `false` | *Optional.* true for MinIO |
| `S3_PUBLIC_URL` | — | *Optional.* public base URL (CDN); empty → presigned GETs |
| `S3_ROOT` | — | *Optional.* optional key prefix inside the bucket |
| `S3_VISIBILITY` | — | *Optional.* public \| private (default: public when S3_PUBLIC_URL is set) |
| `STORAGE_DISKS` | `r2,minio` | *Optional.* More disks: list names in STORAGE_DISKS and set STORAGE_<NAME>_* for each (DRIVER=s3\|local, ENDPOINT, REGION, BUCKET, ACCESS_KEY, SECRET_KEY, PATH_STYLE, PUBLIC_URL, ROOT, VISIBILITY; local disks use ROOT and URL). |
| `STORAGE_R2_ENDPOINT` | `https://<account-id>.r2.cloudflarestorage.com` | *Optional.* |
| `STORAGE_R2_BUCKET` | `uploads` | *Optional.* |
| `STORAGE_R2_ACCESS_KEY` | — | *Optional.* |
| `STORAGE_R2_SECRET_KEY` | — | *Optional.* |
| `STORAGE_R2_PUBLIC_URL` | `https://files.example.com` | *Optional.* R2 custom domain → public disk |
| `STORAGE_MINIO_ENDPOINT` | `http://127.0.0.1:9000` | *Optional.* |
| `STORAGE_MINIO_BUCKET` | `uploads` | *Optional.* |
| `STORAGE_MINIO_ACCESS_KEY` | — | *Optional.* |
| `STORAGE_MINIO_SECRET_KEY` | — | *Optional.* |
| `STORAGE_MINIO_PATH_STYLE` | `true` | *Optional.* |
| `FILES_DISK` | `r2` | *Optional.* |

| Variable | Example | Notes |

| `DOCS_ENABLED` | — | Scalar API docs at /docs (default: on outside production) |

| `OTEL_TRACES_SAMPLER_ARG` | `0.1` | *Optional.* share of new traces kept (parent-based; a caller's sampled trace is always kept) |
| `OTEL_SERVICE_NAME` | — | *Optional.* default: APP_NAME |
| `OTEL_SDK_DISABLED` | `false` | *Optional.* true turns tracing off even with an endpoint set |
| `CACHE_MEMORY_MAX_ENTRIES` | `100000` | *Optional.* memory cache driver bound |
| `SECURITY_HEADERS_ENABLED` | `true` | baseline hardening response headers |
| `CORS_ALLOWED_ORIGINS` | — | *Optional.* comma-separated; empty disables CORS entirely |
| `CORS_ALLOWED_METHODS` | `GET,POST,PATCH,PUT,DELETE,OPTIONS` | *Optional.* |
| `CORS_ALLOWED_HEADERS` | `Authorization,Content-Type,Accept,Accept-Language,X-Acting-Tenant,X-Acting-Branch,X-Acting-User,X-Tenant-Code,X-Branch-Id,X-Request-Id,X-Maintenance-Bypass,Idempotency-Key,traceparent,tracestate` | *Optional.* |
| `CORS_MAX_AGE` | `600` | *Optional.* seconds |
| `MAINTENANCE_CHECK_INTERVAL` | `5s` | *Optional.* how often each process re-reads the maintenance state (ims down/up) |
